original_bug_description: An invalid memory read occurs in zend_ast_export_ex (Zend/zend_ast.c): when exporting certain AST node kinds the function performs an 8-byte read from an invalid address, causing an ASAN-detected crash during AST export/compilation. This can be triggered by crafted input and leads to parser/compiler crashes (denial-of-service).
normalized_bug_description: https://oss-fuzz.com/testcase?key=6291599739584512: php-src has a reported memory-safety bug. An invalid memory read occurs in zend_ast_export_ex (Zend/zend_ast.c): when exporting certain AST node kinds the function performs an 8-byte read from an invalid address, causing an ASAN-detected crash during AST export/compilation. This can be triggered by crafted input and leads to parser/compiler crashes (denial-of-service).
